evidence.quote: Fee treatment should not reduce class recovery or create a reversion incentive.
Class relief and attorneys’ fees were discussed together from the outset; I do not represent that fees were negotiated only after class relief was agreed.

summary: Plaintiff’s counsel raised fee treatment first and fees were discussed from the outset, before the final class fund was agreed. The transcript does not show any tradeoff linking fees or clear sailing to a reduced class recovery, nor any plaintiff self-dealing, defense leverage of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or misleading declaration.
